integrity: The analytic theorem and its proof are included. A high-precision finite-jump checker supplies corroborating calculations but not an infinite mathematical certificate.
scientific_limitations: The exact mean-square law is stationary on the minimal Cantor attractor of the invariant ray, not a pointwise return bound or an off-ray network convergence theorem. The rotation semiconjugacy and geometric gaps are credited to the primary literature; the exact correlation series and Fibonacci error estimate are the new statement. Absolute publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Arithmetic mean-square returns of the Fibonacci Hopfield Cantor attractor
